purpose: Brand-led website for a premium transportation and mobility company: service and fleet pages, instant quote and booking flow with live availability, a bookings API ready for a third-party booking platform, and a scalable content structure for future services.

features.name: Brand site, instant quote, and booking engine
features.description: Northlane: a brand-led six-page site (home, services, fleet, booking, about, contact) with a three-step booking flow, server-computed fares and availability across four vehicle classes and fourteen Bay Area zones, a bookings API (quote, bookings, catalog, contact) that runs unchanged on Vercel, and an unauthenticated dispatcher board at /ops.
features.evidence: 2026-10-22: `node tests/run.mjs` -> PASSED: 226 checks (pricing, booking API, site structure, design tokens, repo hygiene). `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\init.ps1` -> 226 checks passed; validator 100/100. features.name: Payments and deposit rules
features.description: Card capture for one-off bookings and accounts, deposits, cancellation rules, and receipts. Requires the client's provider choice before implementation.
done_criteria: Booking and ops views show payment state

features.name: Third-party booking platform adapter
features.description: Replace the demo availability and store with a provider feed and reservation push, plus a signed webhook that maps statuses into the five the UI understands. See INTEGRATIONS.md.
done_criteria: Bookings are created in the provider

features.name: Staff authentication and dispatch assignment
features.description: Protect /ops, add roles (dispatcher, manager), assign a named chauffeur and vehicle to a reservation, and record the assignment in the audit trail.

features.name: Editable content layer
features.description: Move services, fares, coverage, and FAQ copy into a content source the client can edit without a deploy, with previews before publish.
